items.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Since Abraham Lincoln didn't free the slaves, maybe you can handle it

ctx.x: So, they offered me this job at the Moulin Rouge. It was a brand-new show called Salse Paree, and the producer, Bob Lilly, said, "Well, if you do

this show, if we pick you, you'll be a star after this." It wasn't the last time I heard that. But they wanted to change my name to a French name. I already had a French name and I did not know that my name was French and they didn't know my name was French, but it's true about this country. All of us are to some extent alienated from our ancestors. We don't know. They gave me Gaby which is German, and I already had a French name and kept Wooldridge, which is English. So, I used that name for a year. I worked at…
Which name do you identify with? One name, different -­
